purpose: Combine the conservative vapor equation with vertically turned pressure flow to reduce excessive surface-drag convergence at coasts. control: The original reference keeps adopted r39 numerics and must reproduce all7 archived float32 Ts/Ps/To/Po and geography before other profiles run. The damped reference quantifies numerical drift without changing physics and cannot be selected. Other profiles share the declared .05/1024 damping/work budget; residual tolerance .01, linear tolerance, seasonal calendar and temperature checks remain unchanged. Increased work is not permission to accept a residual above tolerance. Previous256-iteration failures remain failed records, never overwritten or reclassified.
numerical_interpretation: Report changes between reference_damped and reference as numerical sensitivity, not physics skill. Any candidate improvement combines its physical closure and declared numerical work profile and must be measured against actual adopted r39, with the same error tolerances. A qualified full profile records both blocks explicitly; never attribute numerical drift entirely to physics.

Integrated SST MAE increase<=.02C on identical observation-only ice-free padded sea masks; column wind maximum<=60m/s and p95<=25m/s. No partial-case means after failures. Report all6 profiles.

publication: No atlas climate/economic replacement without complete Earth qualification and a separate matched-world fit. Source epochs frozen in a new directory. Numerical controls are not eligible physical candidates; the known over-wet pure-flux replay is diagnostic only.
